requirements.label: 122 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The BM in Voice Performance requires a minimum of 122 credits. Requirements follow the 2024-2025 Silent Advisor; SMTD students follow the curriculum of their admit year.

requirements.label: Non-Music credits (30)
requirements.hint: At least 30 credits outside music. Courses within Arts Administration, Dance, and Theatre also count as non-Music.

requirements.label: Music Theory core (Aural and Written Skills I-IV)
requirements.hint: THEORY 139, 149, 140, 150, 239, 249, 240, and 250. The aural and written skills sequences run across the first two years. JAZZ 220 can be taken in place of THEORY 239 and 249, and JAZZ 221 in place of THEORY 240 and 250 (use an override if you substitute).

requirements.label: 400 level Theory elective (3 credits)
requirements.hint: One 400 level Theory elective.

requirements.label: Musicology core
requirements.hint: MUSICOL 139 Intro to the Study of Music, 140 History of U.S. Musics, 239 History of Music, and 240 History of Western Music.

requirements.label: 400 level Musicology, Theory, or listed Jazz elective (3 credits)
requirements.hint: One 400 level Musicology or Theory elective, or JAZZ 460, 467, 470, or 479.

requirements.label: Class Piano (through PIANO 112 or proficiency)
requirements.hint: PIANO 110, 111, and 112, or demonstrated proficiency. If you place out of any level, use the adjust control to mark it satisfied.

requirements.label: Choral ensemble (8 terms)
requirements.hint: Eight terms of ensemble chosen from the listed choirs. The planner counts one election; repeat it across terms.

requirements.label: ENS 352: Opera Chorus
requirements.hint: One credit of ENS 352 Opera Chorus, required in the fall term of sophomore year.

requirements.label: Performance lessons (32 credits)
requirements.hint: Private voice study every term, four credits per term across eight terms (32 credits total) with completion of VOICE 440. Solo and ensemble participation is subject to the approval of the voice instructor.

requirements.label: Conducting (CONDUCT 315 and 316)
requirements.hint: CONDUCT 315 Elementary Conducting I and CONDUCT 316 Elementary Conducting II.

requirements.label: Opera Performance Skills I-III
requirements.hint: OPERA 139 Performance Skills I, OPERA 239 Performance Skills II, and OPERA 240 Performance Skills III.

requirements.label: Diction (Italian, German, French)
requirements.hint: VOICELIT 201 Italian Diction, VOICELIT 202 German Diction, and VOICELIT 203 French Diction.

requirements.label: THTREMUS 251: Production Practicum I
requirements.hint: One credit of THTREMUS 251 Production Practicum I, taken in the winter term of first year.

requirements.label: Opera electives (4 credits)
requirements.hint: Minimum 4 credits chosen from OPERA 340 Opera Workshop I, OPERA 341 Opera Workshop II, or OPERA 455 Mainstage (Opera Production).

requirements.label: Voice Literature elective (2 credits)
requirements.hint: Minimum 2 credits of Voice Literature electives: VOICELIT 410 Vocal Literature of Black American Composers (African American art song), VOICELIT 411 Czech Vocal Literature, or VOICELIT 450 Chamber Music for Voice and Instruments. The oratorio option also qualifies when offered; the undergraduate catalog lists no oratorio course, VOICELIT 567 is graduate level.

requirements.label: Additional electives in Dance or Theatre (2 credits)
requirements.hint: At least 2 credits of additional electives in Dance or Theatre, in either subject or a mix.

requirements.label: MUSPERF 440: Senior Recital
requirements.hint: Zero credit capstone recital in the final year, taken alongside the 440 level lessons. The minimum vocal repertory requirements (song and aria lists tracked by the voice studio) must also be completed; at least 25 selections are needed to qualify for junior standing.

requirements.label: First year writing
requirements.hint: ENGLISH 124, 125, or an equivalent first year writing course.

requirements.label: Upper level writing
requirements.hint: An upper level writing course approved by the Sweetland Writing Center.

requirements.label: Race and Ethnicity course
requirements.hint: One course in Race and Ethnicity selected from approved courses within LSA, or within SMTD by petition. SMTD RE courses will not count into overall non-SMTD credits.

requirements.label: FRENCH 101: Elementary French
requirements.hint: FRENCH 101 Elementary French with a C- or better, or demonstrated proficiency (use an override if you place out).

requirements.label: GERMAN 101: Elementary German
requirements.hint: GERMAN 101 Elementary German with a C- or better, or demonstrated proficiency (use an override if you place out).

requirements.label: ITALIAN 101: Elementary Italian
requirements.hint: ITALIAN 101 Elementary Italian with a C- or better, or demonstrated proficiency (use an override if you place out).
